name: Janari
description: Janari — public marketing theme for the Jejakawan control plane (single hub, not per-customer Jejakawan).
author: Jejakawan

site_description.label: Site Description
site_description.default: Modern Content Management System built with Laravel and Vue.js

disabled_page_behavior.label: When a page is turned off

disabled_page_message.label: Message shown to visitors
disabled_page_message.default: This page is temporarily unavailable while we improve the experience. Please check back soon.

color_preset.label: Color Preset
color_preset.description: Quick apply curated color combinations. You can still tweak colors manually.

color_intensity.label: Palette Intensity
color_intensity.description: Controls how strong the global color tint appears across cards, borders, accents, and surfaces.

monochrome_variant.label: Monochrome Base Variant
monochrome_variant.description: Control black/white base depth for light/dark mode while accent color stays separate.

monochrome_texture.label: Surface Texture
monochrome_texture.description: Add subtle texture pattern over page background. Works with all presets.

monochrome_texture_strength.label: Texture Strength
monochrome_texture_strength.description: Lower for subtle premium effect, higher for visible texture.

color_background.label: Background Color (stored)
color_background.description: Hidden; light/dark backgrounds use bg_light_color / bg_dark_color in the customizer.

bg_light_color.label: Light Mode Background
bg_light_color.description: Base background color for light mode.

bg_dark_color.label: Dark Mode Background
bg_dark_color.description: Base background color for dark mode.

hero_title.label: Hero Title (fallback)
hero_title.description: Used when locale-specific titles below are empty.

hero_subtitle.label: Hero Subtitle (fallback)
hero_subtitle.default: Editorial Jejakawan and control plane for modern publishing
hero_subtitle.description: Used when locale-specific subtitles below are empty.

hero_subtitle_en.label: Hero Subtitle (English)
hero_subtitle_en.default: Editorial Jejakawan and control plane for modern publishing

hero_subtitle_id.label: Hero Subtitle (Indonesian)
hero_subtitle_id.default: Jejakawan editorial dan control plane untuk publikasi modern

hero_slide_count.label: Number of Slides
hero_slide_count.description: How many background slides to show in the hero carousel

hero_overlay_opacity.label: Overlay Darkness
hero_overlay_opacity.description: Darkness of the overlay on hero images (higher = darker)

hero_news_category.label: Hero News Category Filter (Slug)
hero_news_category.description: Enter category slug to filter news (e.g. pencapaian). Leave empty for all categories.

cta_subtitle.label: CTA Subtitle (fallback)
cta_subtitle.default: Partner with us to deliver modern digital experiences for your team and audience.

cta_subtitle_en.label: CTA Subtitle (English)
cta_subtitle_en.default: Partner with us to deliver modern digital experiences for your team and audience.

cta_subtitle_id.label: CTA Subtitle (Indonesian)
cta_subtitle_id.default: Bermitra dengan kami untuk menghadirkan pengalaman digital modern bagi tim dan audiens Anda.

page_about_subtitle.label: About page subtitle
page_about_subtitle.default: Building a capable, innovative team ready for the future.

page_achievement_subtitle.label: Achievements page subtitle (fallback)
page_achievement_subtitle.default: Celebrating milestones, partnerships, and team achievements.

page_career_subtitle.label: Careers page subtitle (fallback)
page_career_subtitle.default: Connect with opportunities and grow with our team.

page_blog_subtitle.label: News page subtitle (fallback)
page_blog_subtitle.default: Latest announcements, stories, and official updates.

page_contact_subtitle.label: Contact page subtitle
page_contact_subtitle.default: Questions about our services, teams, or partnerships? We are here to help.

contact_form_slug.label: Jejakawan contact form slug
contact_form_slug.description: Slug formulir Reach (Forms) yang aktif dipublikasikan. Default: contact.

contact_email.label: Contact email (theme override)
contact_email.description: Optional. When set, overrides Identity / Public settings for this theme.

contact_phone.label: Contact phone / WA display (theme override)
contact_phone.description: Optional. When set, overrides Identity / Public settings. Also used for WhatsApp CTA on the public site.

contact_address.label: Contact address (theme override)
contact_address.description: Optional. When set, overrides Identity / Public settings.

contact_map_enabled.label: Enable map in contact address popover
contact_map_enabled.description: Show interactive map popup when visitor clicks contact address.

contact_map_source.label: Map source mode
contact_map_source.description: Choose current location or direct map link.

contact_map_link.label: Direct map link (optional)
contact_map_link.description: Paste Google Maps link (supports maps.app.goo.gl) for open/share/directions.

contact_map_zoom.label: Map zoom level
contact_map_zoom.description: Zoom level used in map preview and map links.

home_products_items.label: Product cards
home_products_items.description: Leave empty to use theme defaults. key maps to icon (publishing, reach, intelligence, platform, organization, member).

page_solusi_services_items.label: Services cards
page_solusi_services_items.description: Empty = defaults. key: managed|forms|member|onprem. bullets = one per line.

page_solusi_stack_items.label: Hub stack modules
page_solusi_stack_items.description: Empty = defaults. features = one per line.

home_updates_view_all_url.label: Updates view-all URL
home_updates_view_all_url.description: Shared link for all three View all buttons.

footer_col1_title.label: Footer column 1 title (fallback)
footer_col1_title.description: Used when the linked menu has no name.

footer_col2_title.label: Footer column 2 title (fallback)
footer_col2_title.description: Used when the linked menu has no name.

footer_copyright.label: Footer copyright line (fallback)
footer_copyright.description: If set, replaces the default dual credit line.
